body.history: It was originally implemented with the [[Updates/6.61-6.97|Darashia Update]], before the quest system existed. Back then, the possible rewards were a [[Red Spell Wand]], a [[Time Ring]], a [[Magician Hat]] and a [[Violet Gem]]. With [[Updates/7.24|Update 7.24]], almost 2 years after the quest had been implemented, its rewards were changed to 10k gp, a [[Wooden Wand]], 32 [[Talons]] and a [[Phoenix Egg]]. Lastly, one and a half years later, the wooden wand was replaced by a [[Wand of Cosmic Energy]] on [[Updates/7.6|Christmas Update 2005]].
body.legend: Surpass the wrath of a madman and subject yourself to his twisted taunting.
body.name: The Paradox Tower Quest
body.reward: Up to two of the following: 10k [[gp]], [[Wand of Cosmic Energy]], 32 [[Talon]]s and [[Phoenix Egg]]. You will also get the [[achievement]] [[Mathemagician]].
